::: {.callout-note}
This is a pre-review preprint of a paper presented at the 2nd Workshop in the [Exploring the Layers of Digital Archaeological Practice Series](https://www.uib.no/en/nia/177998/digital-archaeology-workshop-series-2024%E2%80%932027), whose theme for 2025 was [Data and Technology Politics in Archaeology](https://www.uib.no/en/nia/179128/data-and-technology-politics-archaeology).
The workshop was hosted at the Norwegian Institute at Athens from December 3-4, 2025.
